posts.subject: Tryout for test admin?
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello! I wanna tryout to be a test admin. So i am going to tell a little bit about myshelf and tell why i wanna tryout. My name is Hampus and im from Sweden but in the server i go by WHAT/WAIT/WHERE any one of these and maybe in the future WHO (if you guys don´t like my name change i stop i don´t do it 24/7 like 1 time a week or so maybe longer. That means that i speak swedish but i our second languges is English and i have my speaking is real good in my opinion, but not on my writing (and you will properly notice it) im not bad bad at writing but i prefer to use my mic. I am 15 right now but on August 7 i will be 16. My hobbies is gaming, friends and yes...writing my own music, i just do lyrics. I technically don´t have anymore school after this summer break, i still go to a school but i don´t do school work, instead i work as a trainee welder so i know how to take responsibility for my actions. I don´t get mad for nothing either, it´s kinda hard to get me really mad, i can be annoyed yes ofcourse im still human but not that if someone is namecalling me or making fun i don´t care because i know i am more mature then that other person/player.


Why i wanna be a test admin/admin is just the keep the community clean because there is alot and when i mean alot there is ALOT of voicespammers and some rasism and the least problem is non german/english speakers that just don´t care.


I been playing on this server now for quiet a while now and i have gotten to know alot of people now and i am not hated what i know of and i am respected on the server and other well knowed players (even tho my clan name is: Most Hated. the irony in that am i right?) 🤦
I been admin before on a swedish server (csgo) like 2 and ½ years ago and that worked out fine and it was kinda big server (until the server had to be removed for some reason) so i know how to act when dealing with for ex: voicespammer. Calm voice ask them nicely to stop, if they stop fine if not and argue then tell what you are going to do if the continue. I also was a admin on a Minecraft server but i really or i don´t play Minecraft and it also worked out just fine. Not really big server but we had around 500-1000 players playing there, and 150 usual players playing there.


Think that i lack: i know im not 16 yet but i think im mature for my age and my birthday is in the end of this summerbreak for all that go to school. I had German in school but i kinda failed at it so i can´t speak German at all but i understand bits and pieces but it´s not alot.


I can´t really say what times i am available but like whole days basically all days but here are some times that is not 100% but yeah (these are times under this summerbreak and when i started "school" again it will change a little)


Monday tuesday wednesday thursday friday saturday sunday 11:30-23:00 11:30-23:00 11:30-23:00 11:30-23:00 11:30-0:00 12:00-0:30 12:00-22:30


It can be earlier on the day or earlier on the evening



Don´t know much more what i can say really, so if there is any questions or anything that you didn´t understand or whatnot please ask. Thank you for reading this and if you supports this and want me to be a try out. [cookie*]
[ps if it even was a bit small...my bad 😬 ]

You're an awesome guy, however I would say there's a few downfalls...


You're not very active on the forums nor TeamSpeak, and I do believe that you lack grammer in writing also spellings however all this is obviously fixable. I think an ideal Admin should have good spelling and grammer. You're a very friendly and nice guy however the things I listed under my own belief would need improving and also some more detail should be added in this 😄


Lastly I would just like to say good luck with whatever your final verdict may be.
~Swifty

i become more active now on the forums and yes i know my grammer fails on me sometimes and same with teamspeak i am more active there now to but thanks anyway! :3 (and yeah im using my mic instead like 98% of the time)

Hi Hampus,


You are a great friend and player, you can speak English very well, but your grammar is not that good. In my opinion, if you work on your English grammar, you should become an admin.
Good luck :D.



- David.

Hello What/Wait/Where,
First of all it's great to hear from you to apply as a test admin for Dream Knife server, as usual I will go into pros and cons and sum up my throughts.
Pros:
- You speak in game
- You're nice to talk to when you're aviable
- Your aviable hours seem great as this is when admins are not aviable.
- Your hobbies are great
Cons:
- This is your first post on forum
- You're not very active on ts3 as I don't see you in the knife channel
- You joined not too long ago for dream server I suggest you wait a bit and get to know the community more and people to know how you act and behave
- You could have used a Example
- Your punishem on people abusing/ breaking the rules is kinda soft, you will have to be more strict maybe a warning if that does not work the mute after this kick if the kick does not work then it's better to ban them for 30 minutes to let them calm down.


As you can see there is more cons than pros so I will have to say NO but don't worry if you don't pass take the cons into consideration and try to implement these to yourself and next time you will do great.



Kind Regards



Michal "OxygeN" J.

Hello WHAT/WAIT/WHERE,


unfortunately, we can't give you the chance to prove yourself as an test-admin.


Main reasons being:

  • Not well integrated in the community (first forum post, no activity on the TeamSpeak, not known well enough on the servers)
  • You don't meet the age requirement of 16
  • Your application is rather on the bad side with spelling and grammatical errors and it being short


Regardless, we still thank you for your efforts and your will trying to help out the Dream Community.


[abgelehnt-new*]
